crossRefs.note: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in…
Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same king Ahaz.
He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more…
He also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened…
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…

translations.web: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
translations.bsb: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and hail and thunder had ceased, he sinned again and hardened his heart—he and his officials.
